announcements.title: Lab Report Deadline — Friday 5pm
announcements.body: Submit your Fluid Mechanics lab reports on or before Friday 5pm. Reports must follow the standard format. Late submissions attract a 10-mark deduction per day. Ensure data tables are clearly labelled and all graphs properly scaled.
announcements.instructions: Write in ink, include all calculations and raw data sheets. Use the cover page template from the department. Reports should be spiral-bound. Each section must begin on a new page.

announcements.title: No Lectures Wednesday — Faculty Board Meeting
announcements.body: All lectures for Wednesday 25th June are cancelled due to the Faculty Board Meeting. Normal timetable resumes Thursday. This affects all 300L courses. Use the free period to catch up on assignments.

announcements.title: Thermodynamics II CA Test — Confirmed for Friday
announcements.body: The CA test for PRE 321 has been confirmed for this Friday at 10:00am sharp. Coverage is Chapters 6–9 (Entropy, Power Cycles, and Refrigeration). Bring your calculators, a formula sheet (one A4 page, handwritten only), and your student ID.

announcements.title: Makeup Class — Manufacturing Processes Saturday
announcements.body: Mandatory makeup class for PRE 331 this Saturday at 9:00am. We will cover CNC Machining and Additive Manufacturing topics missed during the strike. Attendance counted toward continuous assessment.

announcements.title: Departmental Meeting — All 300L Students
announcements.body: All 300L Production Engineering students must attend the departmental meeting this Friday at 2:00pm. Agenda includes industrial attachment briefing, second semester registration, and election of new student union reps. Attendance is compulsory.

announcements.title: GNS 311 Report Format Updated — Download Now
announcements.body: The Use of English unit has released an updated format for the technical report assignment. The new template includes additional sections on Abstract and Literature Review. Submissions using the old format will be rejected.

announcements.title: MTH 311 Peer Tutorial — Thursday 4pm
announcements.body: Peer-led tutorial session for Engineering Mathematics III this Thursday at 4pm. Topics: Double Integrals, Green's Theorem, and Series Solutions. Student-organised but lecturer-approved. Practice problems have been uploaded to the Materials section.

announcements.title: PRE 311 Week 7 Slides Uploaded
announcements.body: Week 7 lecture slides (Bernoulli's Equation and Applications) are now in the Materials section. Slides include worked examples from Monday's class. We continue from slide 34 in Thursday's lab.

announcements.title: SIWES Industrial Attachment Forms — Deadline July 15
announcements.body: SIWES / Industrial Attachment placement forms are now available at the department office. All 300L students must collect and submit a completed form by July 15th. Failure to submit means you will not be cleared for IT placement. Forms cost ₦500 at the department secretary's desk.

announcements.title: Recommended Resources for Thermo CA
announcements.body: Focus on Cengel & Boles Chapters 6–9. Pay special attention to Clausius inequality proofs and T-s diagrams for ideal gas power cycles. Past exam questions from 2022–2024 are available in the Materials section — very indicative of what to expect.

opportunities.title: MTN Foundation Scholarship 2026
opportunities.description: Full scholarship for Nigerian university students studying STEM courses. Covers tuition, accommodation, and a monthly stipend. Open to 200–400L students with a minimum CGPA of 3.5.

opportunities.title: Shell SIWES Industrial Internship
opportunities.description: Six-month paid SIWES placement at Shell Nigeria for engineering students. Work alongside professionals on real oil & gas projects. Includes mentorship and certificate on completion.

opportunities.title: Google AI for Students Workshop
opportunities.description: Free two-day hands-on workshop on machine learning and AI fundamentals. Learn TensorFlow, build your first ML model, and get a Google certificate. Open to all levels.

opportunities.title: University Engineering Design Competition
opportunities.description: Annual design challenge for engineering students. Build a working prototype that solves a local infrastructure problem. Winners get ₦500,000 and publication in the engineering journal.

opportunities.title: Industrial Training Placement at Dangote
opportunities.description: Structured industrial training (IT) placement at Dangote Group for students in engineering, science, and management. Three to six months duration with stipend and official letter.

opportunities.title: TechQuest Nigeria 2026 — Hackathon
opportunities.description: Nigeria's biggest student hackathon. 48-hour sprint to build a tech solution for education or healthcare. First prize is N1,000,000 and a Silicon Valley trip. Team of 2-4.

opportunities.title: NLNG Science & Technology Scholarship
opportunities.description: Nigerian LNG Limited scholarship for final-year science and engineering students. Covers examination fees, project funding, and post-graduation employment consideration.
